app.name: PlaatCraft
app.long_description:
A Minecraft like voxel sandbox with endless generated terrain, biomes, trees, ores, water and lava.
Hold the Wii Remote with the Nunchuk attached: the D-pad moves, the stick looks around, A jumps or swims up, B sneaks, Z breaks and C places blocks, + and - select a block, 1 toggles flying, 2 toggles the night and Home opens the menu.
